name: Cenes Carinta GmbH

actions.result: Redirect resolves to Cenes Carinta GmbH site; official page exposes WEG, Mietverwaltung, Sondereigentumsverwaltung, Mieterabrechnung, Verwalterwechsel and contact paths.

Page-local operating claims: all services under WEG law/declaration, small WEG units accepted; rental administration covers tenant concerns; rent collection and professional statements; free management-change intake asks for property data and promises a timely consultation.

Registry pages report 2025 house-management asset carve-out into Cenes Carinta GmbH, then August 2026 name/address/management changes; OpenRegister reports the current name as Cenes Carinta - SMART Manage GmbH, new Berlin address and Matti Biskup/Matthias Stokowy as managing directors.
No separate company-bound news/job page was surfaced; registry change is the strongest current trigger.

Official home page exposes phone, contact@cenes-carinta.de, address Am Borsigturm 13 and appointment route; official contact/imprint pages were not fetchable in this pass. Registry discovery names current managing directors, but direct decision-maker contact route remains unresolved.

verified_claims.claim: Cenes Carinta publicly markets Berlin/Brandenburg property administration across WEG, rental, special-property administration, rent accounting and manager changes.
verified_claims.page_local_excerpt: Ihre Hausverwaltung in Berlin und Brandenburg; navigation lists WEG-Verwaltung, Mietverwaltung, Sondereigentumsverwaltung, Mieterabrechnung and Verwalterwechsel.

verified_claims.claim: The site describes concrete operating workflows for WEG compliance, smaller WEG units, tenant administration, rent collection and statements, and a management-change intake form.
verified_claims.page_local_excerpt: Wir erbringen alle Leistungen im Rahmen des Wohnungseigentümergesetzes... Wir übernehmen auch die kleineren WEG-Einheiten; ... Eingang Ihrer Mieten und ... Abrechnungen; kostenfreies Hausverwaltungsmodul.

verified_claims.claim: The legal entity experienced a 2025 house-management asset transfer and August 2026 name/address/management changes.
verified_claims.page_local_excerpt: 18.08.2026 address change; Thomas Nitschke no longer managing director; Matti Biskup and Matthias Stokowy appointed; 26.08.2026 name Cenes Carinta - SMART Manage GmbH.

verified_claims.claim: The official site explicitly invites management-change prospects to submit property data for a timely consultation.
verified_claims.page_local_excerpt: Sie haben Interesse an einem Hausverwaltungswechel?... geben die wichtigsten Immobiliendaten ein und erhalten zeitnah einen Beratungstermin.

hypotheses.hypothesis: The 2025 carve-out plus August 2026 rebrand/management change may indicate an integration, ownership or operating-model transition where systems/process standardization could be relevant.
The free management-change intake indicates openness to replacing incumbent administrators, but does not prove an active internal project or vendor evaluation.

counterevidence: Website copy is primarily marketing language; no disclosed portfolio size, named current properties, implementation case study, job opening or procurement notice was verified.
Registry sources are secondary aggregators, not the primary German register interface; legal-change facts should be rechecked against an official register extract before high-stakes use.
Current legal-name transition creates entity/decision-authority ambiguity: the supplied account name is Cenes Carinta GmbH while current registry discovery reports Cenes Carinta - SMART Manage GmbH.
No budget, incumbent vendor, active internal project, or direct purchase intent was found; preserve Unknown.
why_this_account: Strong target-profile fit: Berlin/Brandenburg WEG and rental administrator with explicit manager-change intake and concrete administration workflows.
why_now: Current legal and management transition in August 2026 is a company-bound change signal; the official site also actively solicits management-change consultations.
recommended_next_action: Verify the current legal name and decision owner through an official register extract or direct company contact; ask only whether the 2026 transition changed property-management systems/processes and whether a defined modernization need exists.
unresolved_decision_gaps: Current legal entity/name and whether supplied account ID should follow the renamed SMART Manage entity
Named operational/economic buyer and procurement ownership
Portfolio/unit count and current growth baseline
Whether any internal modernization, consolidation or vendor evaluation is active
trigger: 2026 legal-name/address/management transition plus explicit management-change lead intake
need_indicator: Confirmed operational complexity; modernization need not confirmed
change_readiness: Medium-High for organizational change; readiness for a specific vendor unknown
access_summary: Public phone, generic email and appointment/intake route on official site; current managing directors identified by registry discovery; direct named contact not yet verified from official contact/imprint page.

name: micasio Home

actions.result: Official homepage identifies a Berlin property manager positioning itself as digital, transparent and personal for owners and tenants.
Homepage exposes separate packages for rental, WEG, special-property management and asset-growth consulting, prices per unit/hour, tenant damage-report route, owner sales phone and inquiry form.
Impressum names micasio GmbH, Dr. Robert Harms and Sebastian Schumann as managing directors, Berlin address, phone and generic contact email; copyright says 2026.
No company-bound job or dated news result was surfaced in the bounded search; official site itself is copyright 2026 but does not establish a dated change event.
News/contact paths were not fetchable in this pass; homepage and impressum provide sufficient identity/access evidence but current change trigger remains unresolved.

verified_claims.claim: micasio targets Berlin owners and tenants with rental, WEG, special-property management and asset-growth consulting packages.
verified_claims.page_local_excerpt: Berlins moderne Hausverwaltung; Leistungspakete list Mietshaus Pro, WEG Master, SEV Pro and Asset Growth.

verified_claims.claim: The company describes concrete operational mechanisms: digital tools/automated processes, visible status/receipts, fixed contacts, separate tenant damage reporting, owner sales line and property-management pricing.
verified_claims.page_local_excerpt: Sie sehen jederzeit, was mit Ihrer Immobilie passiert – Abrechnungen, Status, Belege; Schaden melden; Für Eigentümer & Vermieter ... erstellt Ihnen ein individuelles Angebot; prices from 25.00/29.75/24.00 EUR per unit/month.

verified_claims.claim: micasio explicitly frames its origin around investor/owner pain points: unreachable managers, unclear statements and missing strategic advice.
verified_claims.page_local_excerpt: Wir wissen, wie es sich anfühlt, wenn der Verwalter nicht erreichbar ist, Abrechnungen unklar bleiben und strategische Beratung fehlt.

verified_claims.claim: Named decision access is available through the legal notice: Dr. Robert Harms and Sebastian Schumann are listed as managing directors.
verified_claims.page_local_excerpt: Vertreten durch: Dr. Robert Harms (Geschäftsführer), Sebastian Schumann (Geschäftsführer).

hypotheses.hypothesis: micasio may be an early-stage or actively shaping operator because its website packages services, prices, digital workflow and AI/automation positioning unusually explicitly.

The combination of asset-growth consulting, energy-efficiency language and automation could create readiness for process/software discussions, but no current project or vendor evaluation is evidenced.

counterevidence: Most operational and differentiation statements are self-described marketing copy; no named portfolio, unit count, customer case, implementation partner or third-party operating proof was verified.
No company-bound 2026 job, news item, project announcement or modernization milestone was found in the bounded search; this is an unresolved gap, not a complete absence claim.
No budget, incumbent vendor, active internal project, procurement process or direct purchase intent was found; preserve Unknown.
Official contact/news paths were only partially fetchable, so the named managing directors are verified but their active buying role is not.
why_this_account: Clear target-profile fit for Berlin property administration, including WEG and rental operations, with explicit digital/process and asset-growth positioning.
why_now: The site is current/copyright 2026 and exposes concrete packages, prices, damage workflow and owner acquisition route; however, no dated external trigger was verified.
recommended_next_action: Verify whether the managing directors are the operational buyers and ask a narrowly scoped validation question about the stated pain points (availability, accounting transparency, strategic/energy advice) and any current process-modernization project.
unresolved_decision_gaps: Current portfolio size and operating scale
Whether digital/AI/automation claims reflect deployed internal systems or positioning only
Named operational buyer versus legal managing director
Active internal project, incumbent stack and vendor evaluation status
Current dated trigger beyond website refresh/copyright
trigger: No dated company-bound trigger verified; current 2026 site/package launch is only a weak freshness signal
need_indicator: Marketing-stated pain points and concrete workflow design; operational need not independently confirmed
change_readiness: Unknown to Medium; digital/process posture suggests receptivity but no dated change evidence
